content.overview: Section 2(cc) defines closure as the permanent closing down of a place of employment or part thereof.
content.glance: Section 2(cc) defines closure as the permanent closing down of a place of employment or part thereof.
content.study: Closure means the permanent closing down of a place of employment or part thereof. Notice, compensation and prior-permission rules are in sections 25FFA, 25FFF and 25O.
